title: Horoscopes by Moon sign: daily, weekly and monthly
description: Daily, weekly and monthly horoscopes for all twelve Moon signs, scored by fixed transit rules from the planets' actual positions.
intro: Choose your Moon sign (rashi) and a period. Each horoscope scores love, career, money and health from where the planets actually are, and shows the positions behind every score.

sections.heading: Why Moon signs
body: Vedic astrology reads transits from the Moon sign (rashi), the sign the Moon occupied when you were born, rather than the Western Sun sign. If you do not know your Moon sign, the kundli tool shows it from your birth details. Your Moon sign is often different from the Sun sign you may know from magazines.

sections.heading: How the scores are worked out
body: Each score comes from fixed transit (gochara) rules, not from chance. We take the sidereal position of each planet for the period, count which house it occupies from your Moon sign, and look up whether classical tables treat that house as favourable or challenging for that planet. Each life area weighs the planets most associated with it, for example Venus for relationships and Saturn and the Sun for career.

The weighted result is placed on a five-step scale from challenging to excellent. The same positions always give the same score, and the planets behind every score are listed on the page so you can see the reasoning.

sections.heading: Reading a horoscope sensibly
body: A horoscope describes broad tendencies of a period for everyone who shares a Moon sign. It cannot see your personal situation and it is not a prediction of specific events. Use it as one prompt for reflection; for decisions about health, money or law, speak to a qualified professional.

faqs.q: Is this based on my Sun sign or Moon sign?
faqs.a: On your Moon sign (rashi), as is usual in Vedic astrology. The kundli tool shows your Moon sign from your birth details.

Each planet's house from your Moon sign is checked against classical transit tables, weighted by how strongly it relates to each life area, and the result is placed on a fixed five-step scale. The rules are awaiting review by a vetted astrologer.
Commentary is drafted from the calculated positions and is published only after a person on our team has reviewed it. Until then the page shows the plain facts behind each score.
No. It is for guidance and entertainment and is not medical, legal or financial advice.

faqs.q: How often are the horoscopes updated?
faqs.a: Daily horoscopes change at midnight India time, weekly ones on Monday and monthly ones on the first of the month.
